description: Implementation of bitmap operations for jemalloc, including initialization, size calculation, and handling of bitmap levels and groups, with conditional compilation for tree-based or flat bitmap structures.

methods.name: bitmap_info_init
methods.description: Initializes bitmap information structure, calculating levels and group offsets based on number of bits.

methods.name: bitmap_info_ngroups
methods.description: Returns the total number of groups in the bitmap info.

methods.name: bitmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a bitmap to either all zeros (filled) or all ones (empty), adjusting for trailing bits.

methods.name: bitmap_size
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of the bitmap based on its info structure.
